compareg_masking_bug.found: while killing the cgpio pin-constant mutant: compareg _argcanon collapsed ANY stub-arg value in [0x8, C-text-max] to pointer sentinel 0xFDA00000. Small INTEGER args (pin 9, 0xa, 0x80...) fall in that range -> collapsed -> never compared. This masked a real divergence (v0 hal_write(pin=9) vs mutant v1 hal_write(pin=0xa)) -> false EQUAL.
compareg_masking_bug.impact: integer stub-arg divergences were invisible across ALL units -> a false-equals source (not just cgpio)
compareg_masking_bug.fix: autogen emits g_stub_argptr[] (per-stub pointer-arg bitmask from callee prototypes; unknown proto -> 0x3f = legacy collapse-all, safe). compareg norm() tracks the current stub id from 0xB0 tokens and applies the text/rodata collapse ONLY to pointer args; integer args are compared verbatim.
compareg_masking_bug.validated: cgpio g_stub_argptr={0x0,0x0} (critical_save=void, hal_write=2 ints); baseline still 30/30 (no false mismatch); pin-constant mutant 0x1416 (movs r0,#9->#0xa) now CAUGHT 27/30 (test18 v0 pin=0x9 vs v1 pin=0xa)
compareg_masking_bug.files: stream-private harness: autogen.py (stub_argptr + emit), compareg.py (STUBPTR parse + norm pointer-mask)
